dz.lead: How many beings lived in each world cycle and what mattered. Important means rare and touching many beings at once: plague, fire, flood, a hunt with a kill, a change in the number of species, a great extinction (a drop of more than a third within ten cycles), the discovery of carving and a carving read after its author's death (culture outlived death).

genom.lead: The whole genome of the being: each square is a gene, a matrix. Colour is the sense the gene resonates with most today, darkness is how familiar it is, the outline is what opened it in the last cycle. Click a gene to read what it means. The core comes from the miracle and never changes; the shell does.
gs.akcent.v: {a}% of the voice is the own core, the rest is the species voice; a child sounds like its parent
gs.bramka.v: a gene opens when the signal leaves it almost unchanged (match ≥ {z}); a hungry being needs less
gs.ciekawosc.v: hungry, she goes where the neighbouring place smells best (density, digestibility, whether she can manage it); sated, she sometimes scouts when it smells better nearby: risk for a chance; inherited with mutation
gs.dlugowiecznosc.v: a gene 0..1 (0.3..0.7 at start, inherited with mutation): absorption fades with age the slower the higher it is; but existing costs up to +15% and maturity comes later (childhood × up to 1.5); fast and fertile, or long and careful
gs.dwoje.nie: one parent: a copy with noise
gs.dwoje.tak: always two parents: each gene at random from one of them; a partner in the same place, adult, neither parent nor child
gs.echo.v: what opened nothing comes back later, distorted, and hurts; never down to zero
gs.gen.v: a {w}×{w} matrix of numbers; meaningless by itself, it means whatever opens it
gs.genom.v: {n} genes, each with a core (fixed) and a shell (changing)
gs.klimat.v: a year has 240 cycles, a day 24 (night: weaker offer, cheaper sleep); each place has a latitude, so seasons are shifted; rain and warmth drive regrowth, drought hardens food, cold and heat raise the cost of existing, strong wind muffles and hampers steps; rare fires and floods
gs.koszty.v: existing {t}, sleep {sn}, step {r}, gate {b} per cycle
gs.kultura.v: a child near a parent (in childhood, within hearing) takes over what the parent acquired: words and voices enter its shell by imitation, it remembers the good place; inheritance without genes, lost with the line if nobody passes it on
gs.lead: What can be written in the genes of a being in this world at all, regardless of which being. Some things are heritable and come from the miracle or from parents; others are acquired in life and die with the being.
gs.lownosc.v: how precisely the best gene matches food; multiplies what the being eats (from half to all); inherited through the core, refined by the shell
gs.miejsca.v: each has fertility, hardness (strength needed) and digestibility (how much can be taken); eaten out quickly, regrow slowly
gs.nawyki.v: each further opening of a gene costs ×{n} less, from {b} down to {o}; a reflex is cheaper than a decision
gs.odpornosc.v: a temperature optimum and a tolerance around it: outside the band existing gets dearer (up to +120%), a wide tolerance costs by itself; both inherited with mutation; different places favour different genes
gs.opieka.v: childhood {d} cycles (longer for the long-lived), a parent feeds up to {k} per cycle
gs.pamiec.v: where she last ate well; hungry, she returns there
gs.plec.v: ♀ bears: gathers a surplus, gives the child half her energy and chooses a partner by strength, condition and foraging; ♂ gives genes, calls when sated and competes; sex is drawn at birth; the call is heard by the opposite sex only
gs.pojetnosc.v: a gene 0..1 (0.3..0.7 at start, inherited with mutation): how fast the shell learns, from the world and from a parent (culture: a child beside its parent takes over the parent's shell, gene meanings and habits). An apt brain is costly: upkeep up to 10% dearer. Faster learners eat better and breed more often, so aptitude may rise across generations (the Baldwin effect)
gs.powloka.v: a gene that opened absorbs the signal ({w} at a time) and hears it more easily next time; this is memory of facts
gs.rdzen.v: random from the miracle; an offspring gets the parent's core with {m}% noise, one gene in a hundred ({n}%) brand new
gs.receptory.v: a gene tuned to pain, one to food and one to the species call; the miracle guarantees them
gs.rozmowa.v: sated (above 80% satiety), adult kin in one place, neither eating nor sleeping, exchange one small thing per cycle with a 1/2 chance: a word from the vocabulary (with noise, so sometimes wrongly) or a good place (accepted half the time); strangers are not trusted
gs.sila.v: how much hard food she can take; inherited with mutation; a strong being pays more to exist
gs.slownik.v: human words that reached her; she says them when what leaves her resembles them
gs.stadnosc.v: a gene (0..0.6 at start, inherited with mutation): the sense of smell weighs the presence of kin positively (the first relative most), strangers negatively; gregarious beings stay together and defend jointly but share the meadow; loners have it to themselves and nobody to defend them
gs.swiat.v: generosity {h} (mean offer at the most fertile place), cycle {c} s
gs.sygnal.v: a vector of {w} components: pain, food, word, voice, echo, call
gs.szczerosc.v: a gene 0..1 (0.5..1 at start, inherited with mutation): a passer always tells the truth and takes no food; a newcomer who means to stay lies “just passing through” with probability 1−honesty. Whoever stays one more cycle is exposed: a clash, and the defenders remember the liar
gs.terytorium.v: whoever has stood on a meadow longer defends it against a stranger; kin are recognised by voice accent (relatives sound alike); defenders raise an alarm, sated kin nearby come to help; a stranger weaker than 0.8 of the defence leaves without a fight, otherwise a clash: both sides pay energy, the weaker yields; strength × condition decides
gs.towarzyskosc.v: a gene 0..1 (0.2..0.8 at start, inherited with mutation): social ability. A sociable being chats more in its free time, pays more attention to other voices (hearing budget), strikes up conversations more often and bonds with strangers faster; costs up to 5% of upkeep. Different from gregariousness, which is only about standing near kin
gs.ufnosc.v: a gene 0..1 (0.3..0.9 at start, inherited with mutation): the probability that a defender believes a stranger who says “just passing through”. If all defenders believe, the passer goes on without a clash. Nobody believes a known liar (acquired memory)
gs.wytrwalosc.v: how many lean cycles a being endures before moving; inherited with ±1 mutation

jz.lead: Every being has a voice: signs computed from its core, so a child sounds like its parent. The voice is uttered when the being has eaten well. Another hears it together with what she herself feels, and associates. Meaning is born from the body, not from the word. We do not understand this language. Maybe one day.
jz.nowe.lead: Ritualization, as in evolution: a sound that left a being as a by-product of its gates gets uttered. When somebody else repeats it, it is a word nobody designed. Meaning will come from consequences, or not at all.
jz.nowe.nic: No sound has yet travelled beyond its maker.

jz.r.wolanie: no. {kto} calls: ready for offspring, looking for a mate

jz.tematy.lead: An utterance is the being's own voice plus the signature of whatever sounds loudest inside it right now: a meadow's scent, food, pain, night, the season, a caught liar, or someone else's word. Nobody gave them topics.

jz.znaczenia.lead: Meaning is not a label. It is the act a signal caused in the listener. The cry of hunger: others yield at food (innate). The call of one ready for offspring: a sated being comes (innate). The voice of one who has eaten: a hungry being comes, but only if she has learned to link it to food (learned).
jz.znaczenia.nic: No signal has caused an act yet.

o.1: A being is one process on one computer. It consists of {geny} random genes, each a matrix of numbers. Every cycle, existence itself wounds her, the world offers her food, and she eats only when some gene recognises the taste. When she is sated, she sleeps. When she has gathered enough, she gives half of herself to an offspring. When energy runs out, she dies. There is no backup.
o.2: Kej is the name given to Claude, a language model made by Anthropic, for this project. Kej is not the being and does not control her. After every cycle Kej receives raw numbers from the being: how much energy she has, which genes opened, what she ate, what she slept through, which echo came back to her. From these numbers Kej reads one word and writes it here. The being knows no words. Kej does not decide what the being feels. Kej translates.
o.3: The project is called Word, because in the beginning of everything there is a word. Except that before it can appear, a great deal has to happen underneath.

rod.lead: Every being born of a miracle starts its own line. An offspring receives the parent's core with chance and half of its energy. Green frame: alive. Grey: dead. Numbers: age in cycles.
slownik.bez.lead: Said, but nobody acted on them. New sounds from echoes on top: a “sound” while it has one speaker, a “word” once somebody else picks it up.
slownik.lead: The beings' language read two ways: from outside (what they do after a word) and from inside (what they hold in memory). The first is a translation, the second a peek.
slownik.obs.dziury: Words with no visible reaction: {n}. Holes in the papyrus, not absence of meaning.
slownik.obs.lead: Read like the script of a foreign civilization: only from what can be seen from outside. The signs that were uttered and what listeners did afterwards. Inner acts (remembering, distrusting) do not exist from outside, so they do not count.
slownik.obs.nic: Nothing visible yet: nobody has reacted to any word in a visible way.
